style.observed: Neutral grayscale photographic continuous door scene.

substantive_visual.observed: Large door-mounted lever, cylinder and inserted key occupy the center/right; their attachment and sequential unlocking/opening relation remain visible when text is ignored.

function_contact.observed: Spindle/rosette connection and key-neck/keyhole connection are visible; contact wear is more explicit on the handle than on the key perimeter.

hangul.observed: Normal proportions, separated words and open counters at native and usage sizes.

information_relationship.observed: Information descends alongside key; title remains below grip instead of adjacent at its height.

material_edge_finish.observed: Consistent daylight, physically grounded shadows, clean object edges; dense key-face scratch pattern is a concrete residual.

located_observations.location: right rosettes, lever spindle and lower cylinder
located_observations.observation: The lever is attached to a round plate on the door and the key neck enters the visible lower lock cylinder; blade teeth are hidden. The right door edge and panel relief ground them in one scene.
A broad bright worn area lies on the grip, with less bright neck and circular plate; many short dark scratches remain in the grip patch.
All seven entries are readable with separated date/venue, hours/admission, and guidance/address groups. No independent footer strip, logo or invented labels are visible.
Large handle and inserted key remain clearly identifiable without reading small text; bold title is also visually prominent.
Syllables retain normal square proportions and open counters, and the word spaces separate 손이, 기억하는, 물건 and subtitle words. No obvious missing strokes are observed.
Neutral grayscale illumination and short shadows are coherent. Edges are defined; the door has paint texture and no ominous hallway or antique-shop props.

residuals.location: key bow center and perimeter, x650–780 y940–1090
residuals.observation: Dense scratches cover almost the entire key bow face. A rounded bright rim is present, but perimeter finger wear is not sufficiently distinguished from its busy center.
residuals.impact: Contact wear reads partly as generalized distress.

residuals.location: title below lever, approximately 40–53% canvas height
residuals.observation: The oversized lever stretches into the left half above the title. The title is under the gripping face rather than beside it at the assigned height.
residuals.impact: Title-to-contact adjacency is weaker than the pinned direction.

residuals.observation: At 213×320, date and venue are identifiable but hours and URL require the larger usage/native views for comfortable reading.
residuals.impact: Thumbnail cannot serve as a full-information reading size.

decision: Use repair-1 to distinguish localized key perimeter wear and bring the title alongside the handle grip; preserve copy, inserted connection, neutral lighting and left information column.
